'''Asondo''', also known as '''dried sweet potatoes''' is a crunchy snack from the Tiv tribe of Nigeria, prepared from sweet potatoes.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|Sweet potatoes]]
*Water

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] sweet potatoes in desired shape and size.
#Boil sweet potatoes.
#Dry in the sun for 2 to 3 days or dehydrate using a [[Cookbook:Dehydrator|dehydrator]] until crispy.
